package_name: TikTok Acquisition Breakthrough and Minimum Trusted Connection

strategy_ladder: Public search-index discovery of canonical TikTok video URLs
Official TikTok oEmbed/embed verification of every discovered URL
Clean ephemeral no-cookie public tag/search rendering
Permitted public structured state or public network response inspection
acquisition_technique.preferred_path: public search discovery -> stable TikTok URL/video ID -> official TikTok verification -> metadata parser -> domain mapper -> sanitized fixture -> repeated live smoke
acquisition_technique.strategy_switch_rule: If one method fails, record the failure and move to the next authorized method within the same Queue and correction journal.
acquisition_technique.freeze_rule: Freeze the first reproducible compliant technique only after two live retrieval rounds and MTC evidence.

explicit_out_of_scope: comments, captions, transcripts, private account data or follower enrichment
login, cookies, credentials or user authorization
CAPTCHA, anti-bot, access-control or policy bypass
paid scraping/proxy services or new spending
production write, recurring scheduling or main modification
validation_profile: P54 evidence reuse with no identical request replay
official verification for every retained canonical URL and video ID
two independent bounded live retrieval rounds
at most five retained valid records per topic with deduplication
sanitized fixture replay through the unchanged Generic Runner
Minimum Trusted Connection and early acquisition quality gate
V1/V2 byte invariants plus V3 exact registry resolution and lineage
targeted tests, integration/evidence tests and exact-head full deterministic corpus
one PR, Data Acquisition CI, squash merge and post-merge verification
